summary: Update and improve the “My Health Buddy” app to be simpler, child-friendly, and fully functional, including UI flow simplifications, copy changes, a prominent help button flow, and a working gated “Grown-ups only” settings access.
architectural_notes: Keep the app calm, simple, child-friendly, and easy to understand across all screens and flows.
Grown-ups only gate should support a fallback path if press-and-hold is not supported (maths-only access).

existing_features.title: Rename the helper character from “Amanda” to “Luma” everywhere in the app, and update the greeting copy to exactly: “Hi, I’m Luma. I help you show how you feel.”
Simplify supportive wording by replacing the specified longer sentences with the specified short phrases wherever they appear in the app UI.

Improve the first screen so it only shows: (1) the logo, (2) the Luma character, and (3) one large “Start” button. Move all other menu options to a separate next screen that appears after “Start” is pressed.
Make the “Show this to an adult” button the largest and most visually prominent button in the entire app, and center it on its screen.
Remove scrolling on the feelings selection page by resizing and laying out the feeling option cards evenly so all feeling options are visible on one screen at once.
Add a new location follow-up screen after the user presses the main help button. The new screen must ask “Where are you?” and provide three large buttons: “At school”, “At home”, “Outside”.

Fix the “Grown-ups only” section so it is a real, working button that opens a lock screen flow: require the user to press-and-hold a star for 3 seconds and then answer a simple math question (e.g., 7 + 3). Show the exact error message “Try again, grown-ups only” on wrong answer and open the settings page on correct answer. If press-and-hold is not supported, require only the math question before access.
Ensure all updated and new screens maintain a calm, simple, child-friendly presentation with short, easy-to-understand English UI text.

new_feature_requests.summary: Rename helper character from “Amanda” to “Luma” everywhere and update greeting text to: “Hi, I’m Luma. I help you show how you feel.”
Simplify supportive wording by replacing longer sentences with short phrases (e.g., “Let’s tell a grown-up” and “You did the right thing 💛”).
Make “Show this to an adult” the largest, centered, most prominent button in the app.
Remove scrolling on feelings page by fitting all feeling options on one screen via evenly resized cards (all options visible at once).
Add location follow-up screen after pressing the help button: question “Where are you?” with buttons At school / At home / Outside.
Simplify first screen to only show Logo, Luma character, and one large Start button; move other menu options to the next screen after Start.

Fix “Grown-ups only” section: make it a working button that opens a lock screen requiring press-and-hold star for 3 seconds then a simple maths question; wrong answer message; fallback to maths-only if press-and-hold unsupported; correct answer opens settings.
